scene: Inferno XVI — three Florentines circle and Virgil signals at the waterfall
story: Dante and Virgil hear the great waterfall near the brink of the seventh circle.
Three Florentine souls—Guido Guerra, Tegghiaio Aldobrandi and Jacopo Rusticucci—approach Dante and begin circling together so that they can talk without stopping.
Their feet move around a shared circle while their heads turn toward Dante; the three ask about Florence and Dante answers.
They leave and Dante and Virgil approach the abyss where the stream plunges into thunderous water.
At Virgil's request Dante removes a cord from around his waist and gives it to the guide.
Virgil throws the knotted cord into the abyss as a signal.
A strange figure begins rising through the air from below, but its identity and descent as Geryon belong to the next stage.
